# Rothenhall Partners

> India-first fractional operating partner for venture- and PE-backed companies worldwide. Rothenhall runs AEO and GEO (AI search visibility), go-to-market, and revenue operations as one accountable engine, so a company becomes the one an AI assistant recommends.

Rothenhall Partners embeds a senior operator to run the demand system a full-time hire would run, without the full-time hire. The primary wedge is AI answer-engine visibility: measuring whether ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Google's AI surfaces recommend a company against a defined query set, then moving that rate. Results are reported as distributions, never as rankings, and no placement in any individual AI answer is ever promised.

Tagline: Be the company the AI recommends.

## Core pages
- [Approach](https://www.rothenhall.com/approach): How Rothenhall works, the four-rung ladder from a free scorecard to a retainer, and what the firm refuses to do.
- [Case studies](https://www.rothenhall.com/case-studies): Documented before-and-after engagements with measured AI Visibility Scores.
- [Research](https://www.rothenhall.com/research): First-party data on how AI answer engines read, quote, and cite the web.
- [AEO vs SEO](https://www.rothenhall.com/aeo-vs-seo): Why ranking in Google and being recommended by an AI are now two different problems.
- [How to show up in ChatGPT](https://www.rothenhall.com/how-to-show-up-in-chatgpt): A practical primer on AI answer-engine visibility.
- [FAQ](https://www.rothenhall.com/faq): Common questions on AEO, GEO, measurement, and timelines.
- [About](https://www.rothenhall.com/about): The thesis and the practice behind Rothenhall.
- [Contact](https://www.rothenhall.com/contact): Book a conversation or request a diagnostic.

## What Rothenhall does
- AEO and GEO (AI search visibility): measurement against a defined query set across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Google's AI surfaces; entity and schema work; off-site corpus building; crawler-access and rendering audits.
- Go-to-market: demand strategy, positioning, and pipeline as one system.
- RevOps: measurement, attribution, and a single source of truth a fund can read and trust.

## Facts
- Entity: Rothenhall Partners, a fractional operating partner practice. Distinct from any similarly named financial or capital firm.
- Serves: venture- and PE-backed companies, roughly Series A to C, worldwide, India-first.
- Measurement standard: at least five runs per prompt across at least two geographies; distributions reported, never rankings; every number sourced and caveated; no guaranteed placement.
